user.title: BUSY Bar

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BUSY Bar on your network.

reauth_confirm.description: The stored token for {host} was rejected. Enter the current API token, or leave empty if Password protection is now disabled.

discovery_confirm.title: BUSY Bar
discovery_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant? A token is only needed if Password protection is enabled on the device.

data_description.token: Only required if Password protection is enabled on the device (Settings → API). Leave empty otherwise.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure BUSY Bar
reconfigure.description: Update the host or API token for this BUSY Bar. The new host must point to the same physical device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the BUSY Bar on your network.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check the host and that the device is reachable.
error.unsupported_version: This BUSY Bar runs a firmware whose API is too old for this integration. Please update the device firmware and try again.

abort.wrong_device: The token belongs to a different BUSY Bar.

notify_one_line.name: Notify: one line
notify_one_line.description: Show a single line of text on the front display, with an optional icon, sound and colored background.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to show (up to 80 printable ASCII characters). Long text scrolls automatically.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Optional icon shown to the left of the text.

font.name: Font
font.description: Text font. Sizes differ, so the layout adapts per font. Default: Small (busy 5px).

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Optional stock sound played together with the notification.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the notification stays on screen, in seconds.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Show on top of the running app instead of queuing behind it.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Fills the panel behind the text with this color.

notify_small_two_lines.name: Notify: two lines
notify_small_two_lines.description: Show two short stacked lines on the front display, with an optional icon, sound and colored background.

line_1.name: First line
line_1.description: Top line of text (up to 80 printable ASCII characters).

line_2.name: Second line
line_2.description: Bottom line of text (up to 80 printable ASCII characters).

line_2_color.description: Color of the bottom line of text.

appearance.name: Appearance
appearance.description: Per-line text colors and background color.

notify_picture.name: Notify: picture
notify_picture.description: Show a stock picture centered on the front display, with an optional sound and colored background.

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Optional stock sound played together with the notification.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the picture stays on screen, in seconds.

background_color.name: Background color

simple_timer.name: Simple timer
simple_timer.description: Show a standalone countdown timer on the front display (does not start a Busy session).

sound.name: Sound
sound.description: Stock sound played when the countdown reaches zero.

interrupt.name: Interrupt
interrupt.description: Show on top of the running app instead of queuing behind it.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Start a Busy session. Pick a mode (Infinite / Simple / Pomodoro). Note: Home Assistant cannot grey out fields per mode, so fields that don't apply to the chosen mode are simply ignored.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Timer type: Infinite (open-ended), Simple (a single countdown), or Pomodoro (work/rest cycles).

theme.name: Theme
theme.description: Status theme shown during the session.

work.name: Work
work.description: Minutes. In Simple mode this is the countdown length; in Pomodoro mode it is the work interval.

rest.name: Rest
rest.description: Pomodoro rest interval, in minutes. Must be set together with Cycles.

cycles.name: Cycles
cycles.description: Number of Pomodoro work/rest cycles. Must be set together with Rest.

set_theme.name: Set theme
set_theme.description: Change the status theme of the running session.

play_sound.name: Play sound
play_sound.description: Play a stock sound on the device.

clear.name: Clear display
clear.description: Remove anything this integration drew on the front display.

no_loaded_entry.message: No BUSY Bar is set up yet.

invalid_target.message: The selected target is not a BUSY Bar device.

theme_requires_session.message: Start a session before changing the theme (use the Theme select or the Start timer action).

work_required.message: A Simple timer needs a Work duration. Set the Work field or pick another mode.

pomodoro_pair_required.message: Pomodoro needs Rest and Cycles set together. Provide both, or leave both empty to use the defaults.

time_required.message: Set a non-zero time (hours, minutes or seconds) for the timer.

no_update_available.message: No firmware version is available to install.
